findings.do_not_change: 7-variable 0–9 sum, lactate 0/1/2 and eGFR 0/1/2 bins, risk bands 0–3 / 4–5 / 6–7 / 8–9

findings.name: PRECISE-DAPT (Simplified Educational)
findings.current: Prior bleeding (+15 educational). Age/CrCl/Hb/WBC numeric.
findings.problem: Official variable is previous spontaneous bleeding, not access-site oozing, trivial epistaxis, or traumatic bleed.
findings.suggested_change: Label: Previous spontaneous bleeding (hospitalized / TIMI-style, not access-site or traumatic). helpText: Costa 2017 nomogram item is prior spontaneous bleed. Tool remains educational, not the official nomogram.
findings.research: Costa F et al. Lancet 2017 PRECISE-DAPT (previous spontaneous bleeding)
findings.do_not_change: educational point weights, ≥25 high-band messaging, not-official-nomogram note

findings.name: HCM Risk-SCD (Simplified Educational)
findings.current: Family history of SCD in first-degree relative; NSVT on Holter; Unexplained syncope; Abnormal exercise BP response (optional classic factor). MWT≥30 already numeric.
findings.problem: Hidden official definitions: family SCD age/HCM qualifier; NSVT ≥3 beats ≥120 bpm <30 s; unexplained syncope not vasovagal/LVOTO, especially ≤6 months; abnormal exercise BP failure to rise ≥20 mmHg or fall ≥10–20 mmHg.
findings.suggested_change: helpText only. fhScd: ≥1 first-degree SCD <40 y or SCD at any age if relative had confirmed HCM. nsvt: ≥3 consecutive ventricular beats ≥120 bpm <30 s on 24–48 h ECG. syncope: unexplained TLOC, not neurally mediated or purely LVOTO; strongest within ~6 months. abnormalBP: optional AHA classic marker (not ESC continuous model) — SBP fails to rise ≥20 mmHg or falls ≥10 mmHg during exercise.
findings.research: O’Mahony C et al. Eur Heart J. 2014 HCM Risk-SCD; ESC 2014 HCM footnotes; AHA/ACC 2020 HCM SCD table for BP item
findings.do_not_change: educational factor-count logic, MWT/LA/LVOT numeric handling, not-a-substitute-for-official-% messaging

findings.name: Wellens Syndrome Helper
findings.current: No precordial pathologic Q waves / loss of R progression (slash ambiguous). Normal or only slightly elevated cardiac troponin (no URL multiple). Type A/B already name V2–V3 biphasic vs deep inversion; STE<1 mm on isoelectric.
findings.problem: noQ can be read as no Q waves OR loss of R progression (opposite of Wellens). Classic criteria: no Q waves AND preserved R (e.g. V3 ≥3 mm). Slightly elevated troponin undefined. Type A polarity (initial +, terminal −) omitted.
findings.suggested_change: Relabel noQ to No precordial pathologic Q waves; keep preservedR as Preserved R-wave progression (e.g. R in V3 ≥3 mm). tropNormal helpText: normal or minimally above URL (classic series often <2× ULN). Optional patternA description: biphasic T initial positive then terminal negative, pain-free.
findings.research: de Zwaan C, Bär FW, Wellens HJ. Am Heart J. 1982; standard Wellens teaching criteria
findings.do_not_change: pattern-or + 5-supportive-feature logic, 2/1 weights, avoid-stress-test recommendations

findings.name: Right Heart Strain Flags (PE Helper)
findings.current: Named flags only: S1Q3T3, McConnell’s sign, RV dilation, Elevated TR velocity/RVSP, Elevated troponin and/or BNP, Right axis/RAD strain. T-wave inversion leads and RBBB clearer.
findings.problem: S1Q3T3, McConnell, RV/LV ratio, TR velocity/RVSP numbers, and biomarker URL omitted — cannot tick flags without a definition card.
findings.suggested_change: helpText/longer labels. s1q3t3: S in I + Q and inverted T in III. mcconnell: mid RV free-wall akinesia with apical sparing. rvDilated: RV/LV ≥0.9 or RV appearing larger than LV. trElev: TR velocity ≥2.6–2.8 m/s or RVSP ≳35–40 mmHg. biomarker: troponin or BNP/NT-proBNP above local URL. stRad: QRS axis >+90° or new right-axis strain.
findings.research: ESC 2019 PE RV-strain definitions; McConnell MV 1996; Bova/ESC intermediate-risk PE imaging criteria
findings.do_not_change: 10-flag count, ECG vs echo vs biomarker tallies, high-signature rule (echo≥2 or echo+biomarker)

findings.name: BOVA Score (PE Severity)
findings.current: RV dysfunction (echo or CT) (2); Elevated cardiac troponin (2). SBP 90–100 and HR≥110 already numeric.
findings.problem: Bova RV dysfunction is operational (RV EDD >30 mm, RV>LV / RV:LV ≥0.9–1.0, free-wall hypokinesis, TR velocity ≥2.6 m/s). Troponin is any value above local URL.
findings.suggested_change: rv helpText: RV dilation (EDD >30 mm PLAX or RV>LV / RV:LV ≥0.9–1.0), free-wall hypokinesis, or peak TR velocity ≥2.6 m/s. trop: any cardiac troponin above local 99th percentile URL.
findings.research: Bova C et al. Eur Respir J. 2014 methods (RV dysfunction on TTE/CT; elevated cardiac troponin)
findings.do_not_change: 2/1/2/2 weights, 0–7 total, stage I–III bands

findings.name: NMS Diagnostic Criteria Helper
findings.current: Hyperthermia (typically ≥38 °C); Severe muscle rigidity (lead-pipe); Elevated CK / rhabdomyolysis evidence; Altered mental status. Exposure, autonomic examples, bradyreflexia vs SS better.
findings.problem: CK has no multiple of ULN; AMS is free-form; lead-pipe vs SS clonus named but not how to exam. Cannot decide elevated CK vs mild postoperative rise.
findings.suggested_change: helpText. ck: typically ≥4× ULN or frank rhabdomyolysis. hyperthermia: ≥38.0 °C, often ≥38.5–40 in florid NMS. ams: new drowsiness, mutism, delirium, or catatonia — not baseline psychiatric illness. rigidity: sustained lead-pipe resistance; bradyreflexia favors NMS over SS clonus/hyperreflexia.
findings.research: Gurrera RJ et al. 2011 international NMS consensus; DSM-5 NMS features; Caroff/Levenson reviews
findings.do_not_change: exposure + feature-count logic, classic vs possible thresholds, educational not-a-validated-point-scale framing

findings.name: Burch–Wartofsky Point Scale (Thyroid Storm)
findings.current: Precipitant history Negative (0) / Positive (10). Temp, CNS, GI, HR, CHF, AF already operationally anchored.
findings.problem: Only BWPS item not scorable from the UI is what counts as a precipitant. Typical list missing.
findings.suggested_change: Positive description/helpText: infection, surgery, stopped/irregular thionamide, RAI, iodinated contrast, amiodarone, DKA, CVA/MI/PE, trauma, labor/delivery, exogenous thyroid hormone. If illness vs thyrotoxicosis inseparable, score Positive (original favors diagnosing storm).
findings.research: Burch HB, Wartofsky L. Endocrinol Metab Clin North Am. 1993 BWPS table and precipitant discussion
findings.do_not_change: point values (temp 0–30, CNS 0–30, GI 0/10/20, HR 0–25, CHF 0–15, AF 0/10, precipitant 0/10), ≤24 / 25–44 / ≥45 bands

findings.name: Myxedema Coma Diagnostic Score (Simplified)
findings.current: Metabolic None/One/≥2 lists hyponatremia, hypoglycemia, hypoxemia, hypercarbia, ↓GFR, anemia with no lab numbers. CNS Normal/mild lethargy vs Obtunded/somnolent vs Stupor/coma/seizures. GI present/absent.
findings.problem: Cannot decide whether Na/glucose/PaO2/PCO2/GFR count. CNS obtunded vs somnolent vs mild lethargy has no exam anchors. Educational bins are fine; empty lab bins are not.
findings.suggested_change: Keep simplified 0/10/20 values. metabolic helpText teaching cutoffs (not extra points): e.g. Na <130–135, glucose <60 mg/dL, PaO2 <60 or new O2 need, PaCO2 >45–50, AKI below baseline. cns descriptions mapping original 0/10/15/20/30 into the three bins. gi: present = anorexia, constipation, hypoactive bowel, or ileus/megacolon. Do not restore full original itemization in calculate().
findings.research: Popoveniuc G et al. Endocr Pract. 2014 Table 1
findings.do_not_change: simplified category values, +10 known-hypothyroidism, ≤24 / 25–59 / ≥60 bands

findings.name: Metabolic Syndrome (NCEP ATP III)
findings.current: Waist Yes/No is Elevated waist circumference (sex-specific ATP III threshold). Actual numbers (men >102 cm / 40 in; women >88 cm / 35 in) live only on the sex dropdown. TG/HDL/BP/glucose already quote numbers.
findings.problem: Easy to miss the cutoff if the user does not re-read Sex. helpText unused on waist.
findings.suggested_change: helpText on waist: ATP III >102 cm (40 in) men, >88 cm (35 in) women. Treated dyslipidemia/HTN/hyperglycemia still count. IDF ethnicity-specific waist is not this tool.
findings.research: NCEP ATP III final report (Circulation 2002) waist cut-points
findings.do_not_change: 5 dichotomous criteria, ≥3 diagnosis rule

findings.name: Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence
findings.current: Difficult to refrain in no-smoking places. Other five FTND stems are close to Heatherton wording.
findings.problem: Official item 2 examples (church, library, cinema / forbidden places) omitted. Not copyright-locked like MMSE.
findings.suggested_change: Label/helpText: Do you find it difficult to refrain from smoking in places where it is forbidden (e.g. church, library, cinema, airplane)? Keep 0/1.
findings.research: Heatherton TF et al. Br J Addict. 1991 FTND six-item wording

findings.name: US Navy Body Fat Estimate
findings.current: Waist helpText: male abdomen at navel / female waist at narrowest. Hip helpText only Required for female equation. Neck has no landmark. Units inches.
findings.problem: Hodgdon protocol needs neck just inferior to the larynx (tape perpendicular) and hip at maximal buttocks protrusion. Without landmarks the method is noisy.
findings.suggested_change: helpText: neck just below the larynx, perpendicular to long axis; hip (women) greatest protrusion of buttocks; all circumferences and height in inches.
findings.research: Hodgdon JA, Beckett MB. NHRC 84-11 / 84-29 US Navy circumference procedures
findings.do_not_change: log10 male/female equations, inch units, invalid-measurement guards

findings.name: Waist–Hip Ratio (WHR)
findings.current: Bare Waist circumference / Hip circumference in cm. WHO site only in a pearl.
findings.problem: Waist protocol varies (umbilicus vs WHO midpoint vs iliac crest). helpText unused.
findings.suggested_change: helpText: WHO waist at midpoint between lowest rib and iliac crest, end-expiration; hip at widest buttocks. Same units (cm).
findings.research: WHO 2008 waist circumference and waist–hip ratio expert consultation
findings.do_not_change: WHR = waist/hip, sex cut-points 0.90 / 0.85
